title: Wazuh · FIM: что изменилось на хостах
description: Контроль целостности файлов (syscheck): какие файлы, на каких хостах, кем и когда. Источник — алерты Wazuh с группой syscheck.

panels.title: Изменений файлов
panels.sql: SELECT count() AS `всего`, countIf(JSONExtractString(raw,'syscheck','event') = 'added') AS `добавлено`, countIf(JSONExtractString(raw,'syscheck','event') = 'modified') AS `изменено`, countIf(JSONExtractString(raw,'syscheck','event') = 'deleted') AS `удалено` FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE has(rule_groups,'syscheck') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: Хосты с изменениями
panels.sql: SELECT uniqExact(agent_name) AS `хостов`, uniqExact(JSONExtractString(raw,'syscheck','path')) AS `файлов` FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE has(rule_groups,'syscheck') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: Изменения по времени и типу
panels.sql: SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS t, JSONExtractString(raw,'syscheck','event') AS event, count() AS n FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE has(rule_groups,'syscheck') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY t, event ORDER BY t

panels.title: Хосты по числу изменений
panels.sql: SELECT agent_name AS `хост`, count() AS `изменений` FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE has(rule_groups,'syscheck') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY `хост` ORDER BY `изменений` DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Самые «живые» файлы
panels.sql: SELECT JSONExtractString(raw,'syscheck','path') AS `путь`, uniqExact(agent_name) AS `хостов`, count() AS `событий`, max(toString(timestamp)) AS `последнее` FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE has(rule_groups,'syscheck') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY `путь` ORDER BY `событий` DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Критичные пути: /etc, sudoers, ssh, cron, бинарники
panels.sql: SELECT toString(timestamp) AS `время`, agent_name AS `хост`, JSONExtractString(raw,'syscheck','event') AS `событие`, JSONExtractString(raw,'syscheck','path') AS `путь`, JSONExtractString(raw,'syscheck','uname_after') AS `владелец`, JSONExtractString(raw,'syscheck','perm_after') AS `права` FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE has(rule_groups,'syscheck') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND match(JSONExtractString(raw,'syscheck','path'), '^/(etc/(passwd|shadow|sudoers|ssh|cron)|usr/local/bin|usr/bin|bin|sbin)(/|$)') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Последние изменения
panels.sql: SELECT toString(timestamp) AS `время`, agent_name AS `хост`, JSONExtractString(raw,'syscheck','event') AS `событие`, JSONExtractString(raw,'syscheck','path') AS `путь`, rule_id AS `правило`, rule_level AS `уровень`, substring(JSONExtractString(raw,'syscheck','md5_after'),1,12) AS md5 FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE has(rule_groups,'syscheck') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
